thread:
sarah (Support): Heads-up: GreenWave Media submitted a form asking for a 10x embeddings rate uplift (60 -> 600 RPS) for a 48h campaign. No signed contract on file; they say they will pay.
aj (Sales): I talked to their PM. They're running an A/B personalization test. Said finance will PO today but nothing received yet.
ops-bot: [threat-detection] 3 new API keys created from same /24 in last 36h :warning:
mina (Product): We need to triage product + fraud risk. Ask for sample payloads (avg tokens, model id), expected concurrency curve, and billing contact verification.
kai (Security): Ops-bot flag looks suspicious. Are API key creators tied to the company email? Any billing vs signup email mismatch? Paste any request headers if available.
aj (Sales): Signup email domain is greenwave.co, billing uses a gmail. Company reg address in a different state than the billing address.
jordan (Eng): From infra standpoint, 600 RPS sustained embeddings may require a temp isolated pool. We can spin one but prefer reserved capacity if this is recurring.
mina (Product): Product proposal: deny permanent uplift until PO + ID. Offer 24h temporary uplift with strict guardrails: per-key burst caps, IP allowlist, cost limits, and live telemetry. Convert to reserved if paperwork completed.
sarah (Support): I can request company registration docs + PO and ask for a 1-paragraph use-case summary.
kai (Security): Also require customer to provide sample queries and pass identity verification. If anomalies detected (multiple lookalike accounts, synthetic payloads), revoke uplift immediately.
aj (Sales): I'll push for PO and can set a quick Zoom verification. If they sign today we can fast-track.
jordan (Eng): Guardrail example we can apply now:
```
rate_limit: 600rps_total
per_key_burst: 150rps
window: 60s
ip_allowlist: ["3.120.45.0/24"]
monitoring: true
anomaly_threshold: 3x_baseline
```
mina (Product): Acceptance criteria to create a backlog item: 1) Signed PO/contract + billing verification, 2) Security checks green, 3) Monitoring + rollback plan documented, 4) Docs updated (quota & cost notes). If any missing, keep uplift temporary.
sarah (Support): Next steps: AJ to collect PO and schedule call (ETA today). Me to run fraud checklist and paste findings. Kai to confirm gating rules. Jordan to draft temp-pool runbook.
kai (Security): Running fraud scripts now — will post evidence here. If we see synthetic patterns or smoke signals, we block all uplifts.
ops-bot: [audit] Ticket INF-4371 created for temp uplift deployment :white_check_mark:
mina (Product): Please include model (embedding-large-v2), expected token sizes, log retention window, and rollback owner in the backlog description.
aj (Sales): I'll update INF-4371 with PO status. If PO delayed >48h, we revert to baseline and notify customer.
sarah (Support): Marking triage complete. I'll update thread when fraud check finishes. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
